field_objectives.label: Bramble Screen
field_objectives.summary: The thorn-choked berm lets the grove raiders fire from cover and keeps the hexer screened until the bank is stormed.

field_objectives.label: Gate Breach
field_objectives.summary: The side that controls the broken gate controls whether the assault stalls at the wall or spills into the yard.

field_objectives.label: Site Perimeter
field_objectives.summary: The stationed force controls the field site's approaches until the perimeter is broken.

field_objectives.label: Levee Stake Choke
field_objectives.summary: The levee stakes keep the bank tight and bleed momentum until the barrier is ripped apart.

field_objectives.label: Chain Slinger Lane
field_objectives.summary: The ferry-chain slingers keep the open lane murderous until the bank is stormed.

field_objectives.label: Levee Break
field_objectives.summary: Whoever forces the levee break controls the late melee collapse.

field_objectives.label: Drum Circle Pylon
field_objectives.summary: The shrine drums keep stealing tempo until the pylon ring is broken.

field_objectives.label: Silt Sink
field_objectives.summary: The drowned lane keeps chewing cohesion unless the safer footing is seized.

field_objectives.label: Lantern Kill Lane
field_objectives.summary: The patrol's lantern battery keeps the road under ranged pressure until the rise is taken.

field_objectives.label: Road Signal Beacon
field_objectives.summary: A signal mast keeps command steadier and makes the battery harder to break.

field_objectives.label: Charter Pike Gate
field_objectives.summary: The charter pike gate keeps the assault compressed until the barrier line is forced open.

field_objectives.label: Charter Supply Post
field_objectives.summary: Fresh reserves and steadier shields flow through the charter supply post.

field_objectives.label: Bastion Signal Mast
field_objectives.summary: The bastion signal mast keeps the reserve line coordinated under pressure.

field_objectives.label: Reed Totem Ring
field_objectives.summary: The totem ring keeps beating on the line's cohesion until the circle is broken.

field_objectives.label: Fen Hazard Lane
field_objectives.summary: The soaked reeds punish the side that fails to take the firmer bank.

field_objectives.label: Bone Rack Blind
field_objectives.summary: The ferry's rackwork blinds keep the watchers screened while they rake the lane from cover.

field_objectives.label: Ferry Chain Choke
field_objectives.summary: The dropped ferry chains keep the causeway clogged until the choke is hacked clear.

field_objectives.label: Bridge Barricade
field_objectives.summary: The bridge barricade keeps the crossing narrow until the levy wall is broken apart.

field_objectives.label: Lens Bulwark
field_objectives.summary: The mirrored lens bulwark keeps the pickets screened while the relay crews hold the firing line.

field_objectives.label: Relay Kill Lane
field_objectives.summary: The mirrored relay lane magnifies ranged pressure until the lens crews are displaced.

field_objectives.label: Relay Signal Beacon
field_objectives.summary: A relay beacon keeps the firing line synchronized and command harder to expose.

field_objectives.label: Prism Shelter Line
field_objectives.summary: The prism shelters keep the matrix crews screened while the arrays hold the long lane.

field_objectives.label: Daybreak Kill Lane
field_objectives.summary: The matrix arrays keep the approach under concentrated battery fire until the lane is turned.

field_objectives.label: Array Relay Depot
field_objectives.summary: The relay depot feeds fresh crews and steadier reserves into the matrix line.

field_objectives.label: Daybreak Beacon
field_objectives.summary: The daybreak beacon keeps the arrays synchronized and command tempo protected.

field_objectives.label: Toll Stores
field_objectives.summary: The lodge keeps spare shafts, bolts, and pay chests behind the front line until the yard is secured.

field_objectives.label: Kennel Run
field_objectives.summary: The kennel run gives the hounds a clean rush lane until the firmer ground is taken.

field_objectives.label: Wind Perch
field_objectives.summary: The high perch keeps the roost crews coordinated until the approach ridge is taken.

field_objectives.label: Barge Stores
field_objectives.summary: Spare poles, nets, and lamp oil keep the mooring defenders supplied until the dock is secured.

field_objectives.label: Spore Beds
field_objectives.summary: The glowing beds make the tunnel approach treacherous until the crop rows are controlled.

field_objectives.label: Repair Pile
field_objectives.summary: The repair pile feeds spare blades and bow arms into the watch until the yard is claimed.

field_objectives.label: Hot Kiln Yard
field_objectives.summary: Open furnace trenches punish a rushed assault until the kiln yard is taken.

field_objectives.label: Storm Beacon
field_objectives.summary: The storm beacon keeps the bothy watch coordinated across the white road.

field_objectives.label: Orchard Stores
field_objectives.summary: Food stores and tool sheds let the levy keep rotating fresh crews into the lane.

field_objectives.label: Bramble Screen
field_objectives.summary: The screen hides hedge fighters until the thorn line is pushed back.

field_objectives.label: Skiff Racks
field_objectives.summary: Boat racks and tide marks keep the skiffyard crews moving until the beach is held.

field_objectives.label: Guide Stores
field_objectives.summary: Guide ropes and packed stores let the hostel watch hold the switchback longer than expected.

field_objectives.label: Blinding Flats
field_objectives.summary: White flats and salt glare keep attackers exposed until the camp center is taken.

field_objectives.label: Crystal Choke
field_objectives.summary: Reflective stone breaks sight lines and protects the sump defenders until the choke is cleared.

field_objectives.label: Snare Line
field_objectives.summary: Hidden snare lines break a careless approach until the lodge path is found.

field_objectives.label: Glass Scar
field_objectives.summary: Knife-edged scar glass narrows the approach and protects the camp line.

field_objectives.label: Coppice Screen
field_objectives.summary: Layered coppice rows hide the copse watch until the trail center is held.

field_objectives.label: Flaremast
field_objectives.summary: The flaremast lets pilots coordinate beach routes until the house is secured.

field_objectives.label: Kite Mast
field_objectives.summary: Signal kites keep the eyrie watch moving faster until the mast is grounded.

field_objectives.label: Oil Niche
field_objectives.summary: Lamp oil and needle stores keep the warren watch effective until the niche is taken.

field_objectives.label: Bell Path
field_objectives.summary: Bell-marked mud lanes confuse the approach until the croft center is held.

field_objectives.label: Milestone Stores
field_objectives.summary: The arsenal storeyard keeps spare bucklers and cartbows flowing until the milestone is claimed.

field_objectives.label: Iced Wharf
field_objectives.summary: Iced planks and signal lamps let the wharf guard keep its footing until the house is held.

field_objectives.label: Coal Clamp
field_objectives.summary: Smoking coal clamps make the center lane dangerous until the camp is scattered.

field_objectives.label: Basalt Gate
field_objectives.summary: The gate throat turns every approach into a narrow breach until the custodians are broken.

field_objectives.label: Bramble Gate
field_objectives.summary: Root screens make the lane hard to read until the gate line is forced open.

field_objectives.label: Tally Post
field_objectives.summary: Contract ledgers keep the foundry line supplied until the post is seized.

field_objectives.label: Fog Bell
field_objectives.summary: The harbor bell hides privateer movement until the signal frame is claimed.

field_objectives.label: Broken Sluice Battery
field_objectives.summary: Turncoat bargebows range the causeway through a stolen lockgate until the battery frame is taken.

field_objectives.label: Moonhunt Scent Gate
field_objectives.summary: Mossglass scent braziers turn the reed lanes into a hunting maze until the antler gate is broken.

field_objectives.label: Parallax Chime Frame
field_objectives.summary: A forked mirror choir keeps every ray in cadence until the suspended prism is claimed.

field_objectives.label: Walking-Root Arch
field_objectives.summary: A living pilgrim arch advances thorn screens over the lane until its graft baskets are cut down.

field_objectives.label: Seizure Gauge
field_objectives.summary: A red gauge wheel releases rivets and scrip to the foreclosure line until its counterweight is seized.

field_objectives.label: Drowned Procession Bell
field_objectives.summary: A funeral bell sounded from a ribbed skiff drives the procession onward until the mast is silenced.

field_objectives.label: Sunken Toll Chest
field_objectives.summary: Drowned ledgers and a toll bell keep the wreck-claimants paid until the chest is seized.

field_objectives.label: Prism Censor Reliquary
field_objectives.summary: A censor cage refracts the inquest's commands until its mud-sealed reliquary is opened.

field_objectives.label: Redline Calibration Gate
field_objectives.summary: A pressure gauge and mirror calipers feed exact firing lines until the rail barricade is taken.

field_objectives.label: Briarbound War Drum
field_objectives.summary: A root-choked drum keeps the cordon moving in step until its thorn lashings are cut.

field_objectives.label: Charter Lockgate Railhead
field_objectives.summary: A burning charter seal holds the audit line together until the lockgate counterweight falls.

field_objectives.label: Graftwake Root Mooring
field_objectives.summary: A living bollard traps the wreck mast and shelters the cordon until its ghost-rope is severed.

field_objectives.label: Peat-Chain Tally Pit
field_objectives.summary: Peat-Chain Tally Pit anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Meridian Prism Impound
field_objectives.summary: Meridian Prism Impound anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Furnace Railblock
field_objectives.summary: Furnace Railblock anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Drowned Seed Bell
field_objectives.summary: Drowned Seed Bell anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Lockfire Chain Buoy
field_objectives.summary: Lockfire Chain Buoy anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Rootwake Ghost Mast
field_objectives.summary: Rootwake Ghost Mast anchors the enemy line until its outer-reach claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Hive-Chain Foreclosure
field_objectives.summary: Hive-Chain Foreclosure anchors the hostile frontier line until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Reedflame Votive Gate
field_objectives.summary: Reedflame Votive Gate anchors the hostile frontier line until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Drowned Mirror Battery
field_objectives.summary: Drowned Mirror Battery anchors the hostile frontier line until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Rootbound Survey Lens
field_objectives.summary: Rootbound Survey Lens anchors the hostile frontier line until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Blackwake Obituary Mooring
field_objectives.summary: Blackwake Obituary Mooring anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Daybreak Reed Prism
field_objectives.summary: Daybreak Reed Prism anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Foundry Eclipse Gauge
field_objectives.summary: Foundry Eclipse Gauge anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Cinderwrit Graft Brazier
field_objectives.summary: Cinderwrit Graft Brazier anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Gorefen Debt Totem
field_objectives.summary: Gorefen Debt Totem anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Worldroot Wake Seal
field_objectives.summary: Worldroot Wake Seal anchors the enemy ascendant company until its claim is broken.

field_objectives.label: Writ Press
field_objectives.summary: The collectors renew their stamped claims until Harro captures the mobile writ press.

field_objectives.label: False Meridian
field_objectives.summary: A misaligned fog beacon keeps the pilots one route ahead until Orso seizes its charting ring.

field_objectives.label: Briarwheel Breach Gate
field_objectives.summary: The living gate keeps the Canopy Rammers root-set until its outer braces are claimed.

field_objectives.label: Cindercoil Pressure Rail
field_objectives.summary: The rail primes each lancer's boiler until its control gauge is seized.

field_objectives.label: Gloamwake False Meridian
field_objectives.summary: A suspended wakeglass compass mischarts every clear route until its silver bearing ring is turned.

field_objectives.label: Beaconline Writ Post
field_objectives.summary: The raised writ-lantern keeps every defending volley measured until its charter line is crossed.

field_objectives.label: Sunk Fenbell Toll
field_objectives.summary: A half-drowned bell marks every safe footing for the Chainstalkers until its mire ring is seized.

field_objectives.label: Zenith Survey Battery
field_objectives.summary: The calibrated aperture measures every open lane until its sighting ring is turned away from the field.

field_objectives.label: Banked Vent Ring
field_objectives.summary: The fold's banked vents keep the aurochs' first charge hot until the stone ring is seized.

field_objectives.label: Resonator Causeway
field_objectives.summary: The suspended bells measure every open approach until their saltstone causeway is taken.

field_objectives.label: Crown-Root Line
field_objectives.summary: Old crown roots keep the knucklebears braced until the interlocked thorn line is broken.

field_objectives.label: Resonant Throat Pool
field_objectives.summary: The basin water multiplies every bell-croak until its center is seized and stilled.

field_objectives.label: Wind-Cut Notch
field_objectives.summary: The striders own the downhill break until the narrow wind-cut notch is forced.

field_objectives.label: Lantern Drift Lane
field_objectives.summary: A line of mineral scales measures every exposed approach until the drift's anchor is captured.

field_objectives.label: Whitewake Chime
field_objectives.summary: The chime keeps the four-winged hunters inside a folding rime bank until its bearing is taken.

field_objectives.label: Seventh Vault Seal
field_objectives.summary: The final seal keeps the vaultwyrm's blackstone plates interlocked until the pylon ring is controlled.

field_objectives.label: Charter Sluice Line
field_objectives.summary: The raised floodgate keeps the assize line supplied until both charter keys are taken across the causeway.

field_objectives.label: Moonfang Snare Pool
field_objectives.summary: The antler drum marks every safe reed step until its half-drowned bell and chain ring are seized.

field_objectives.label: Three-Fork Sighting Ring
field_objectives.summary: Three tuned forks keep the prism battery aligned until the mirrored ring is turned off the open lane.

field_objectives.label: Oathseed Shelter Arch
field_objectives.summary: Braided roots shelter the ring's formation until the sporeglass vents and crowned seed are reached.

field_objectives.label: Redline Judgment Rail
field_objectives.summary: The blast screens hold while the black bell stays inside its marked pressure interval; force the brass rail before it sounds.

field_objectives.label: Last-Safe Sounding Bell
field_objectives.summary: The tideglass bell keeps the ghost ropes taut until its pale quay bearing is claimed before the final chime.
